changed_vs_main176.derived: engine pins + PIPELINE + Oracle query plan metadata
changed_vs_main176.sql_plans: 643 -> 645 (two SELECTs listing the earlier investigations of the same chat; r7 of the related-question work)

changes.related_questions_then_decide: every earlier question of the chat (across investigations, last 20) is judged YES/NO/UNSURE per question (one model call), the decision uses only the related ones; UNSURE only -> ask "이번 요청이 n번째 질문 “…”에 대한 것인가요?"; the reply runs the pending request
changes.connected_continues: user rule 2026-11-08: anything connected to an earlier question (same body/system/case, another article or aspect) continues it; an explicit new-question wording (새로 찾아줘, 새 질문으로, 별도로) starts a new one; a different body/system/law is a new question
changes.part_re_show: ANSWER_PRESENT asking for one part of an earlier answer shows only the saved explanations holding it (one claim-choice call, IDs only, no search, no new text); the saved judgment keeps every claim; WHOLE/invalid/all-claims keeps the full re-show
changes.clarification_wording: the question is named by what the user actually asked, not by the model-written purpose (S8: "상법상 …" disappeared)
changes.grant_restore: persisted reference read grants that no current acquired original witnesses are dropped (event SCOPE_REFERENCE_GRANT_DROPPED), never HTTP 500 (MAIN176 S4 "persisted reference scope has no current verified witness"); grants of another search scope are dropped too
changes.unresolved_decision_answers: MODEL_DECISION_UNRESOLVED with acquired originals answers from them as a limited answer with the stop note; without originals it still asks (ADR-1451 "판단 처리 오류" path)
changes.reviewer_consistency: a reviewer task paraphrase on an unchanged-purpose command, or valid=false naming the relation of the very command while demanding a different task text, is recorded (COMMAND_CHECK_OVERRIDE), not refused; task-keeping rejections and FOLLOWUP/NEW_TOPIC disagreements still refuse
changes.guidance_rules: a law named for an unanswered question is its guidance even when another law was searched; background answers are not acquired originals (navigation prompt)
